summary_1line: Ravana angrily rebukes his charioteer for retreating from battle with Rama, but the charioteer calmly explains he withdrew to save the exhausted king and horses.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana, eyes blazing red with fury in his towering chariot, angrily confronts his calm charioteer amid the dust of the retreating battlefield.
The exhausted Ravana slumps in his war chariot while the charioteer turns the thunderous vehicle away from Rama's storm of arrows.
